# docs/audit — the historical record and the closure records

This directory has two roles: the archive, and the record layer.

- [`closure-records.md`](closure-records.md) — per-workstream closures (the archive).
- [`plan-reviews.md`](plan-reviews.md) — plan reviews, with their proposals.
- [`register.md`](register.md) — the global list of open findings carried across work items.
- [`findings/`](findings/F1.md) — the evidence essay for a register row too long to carry
  inline.

## Conventions

- **Existing-id naming.** A work item is named by its existing id.
- **Evidence is write-once.** A record that changes after the fact must say it changed.
- **ISO dates.** All dates are ISO 8601, for example `2026-08-27`.
